name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

summary.oneLiner: ₹6,000 a year for farmer families who own agricultural land.
summary.whatIsIt: PM-KISAN gives money to farming families who own land. If you qualify, the government sends ₹2,000 to your bank account every four months — ₹6,000 a year in total. You never have to repay it. Income tax payers, government employees, pensioners above a limit, and professionals like doctors cannot get this benefit.

benefits.text: Direct cash support paid straight to your bank account, no middlemen

whoCanApply: You own farming land in your family's name
notFor: Anyone with a government employee in the family
Pensioners getting ₹10,000 or more a month
Doctors, engineers, lawyers and similar registered professionals
Institutional landholders (land owned by a company or trust, not a person)

documents.name: Bank account (linked to Aadhaar, for e-KYC)

howToApply.title: Complete e-KYC
howToApply.detail: Do e-KYC on the PM-KISAN portal or at your nearest Common Service Centre.

howToApply.title: Register with your land records
howToApply.detail: Submit your land ownership papers and bank details to your local agriculture officer or online.

howToApply.title: Track your payment
howToApply.detail: Check your instalment status on the PM-KISAN website using your Aadhaar number.

rules.label: You own farming land in your family's name
rules.sourceQuote: All landholder farmer families, which have cultivable landholding in their names, are eligible to get benefit under the scheme.

exclusions.label: Income tax payers
exclusions.sourceQuote: Any person who paid income tax in the last assessment year.

exclusions.label: Anyone with a government employee in the family
exclusions.sourceQuote: All serving or retired officers and employees of Central/State Government Ministries/Offices/Departments (except Group D/Class IV/Multi Tasking Staff employees).

exclusions.label: Pensioners getting ₹10,000 or more a month
exclusions.sourceQuote: Retired pensioners whose monthly pension is Rs. 10,000 or more (excluding Multi Tasking Staff / Class IV / Group D employees).

exclusions.label: Doctors, engineers, lawyers and similar registered professionals
exclusions.sourceQuote: Professionals like Doctors, Engineers, Lawyers, Chartered Accountants and Architects registered with professional bodies and carrying out profession by undertaking practices.

customQuestion.en: Is your farmland owned by an institution (company, trust or similar), not by you or your family personally?
customQuestion.hi: क्या आपकी खेती की जमीन किसी संस्था (कंपनी, ट्रस्ट आदि) के नाम पर है, न कि आपके या आपके परिवार के नाम पर?
customQuestion.te: మీ వ్యవసాయ భూమి మీది లేదా మీ కుటుంబానిది కాకుండా ఒక సంస్థ (కంపెనీ, ట్రస్ట్ వంటివి) పేరిట ఉందా?
customQuestion.ta: உங்கள் விவசாய நிலம் நீங்கள் அல்லது உங்கள் குடும்பத்தின் பெயரில் இல்லாமல் ஒரு நிறுவனத்தின் (நிறுவனம், அறக்கட்டளை போன்றவை) பெயரில் உள்ளதா?

exclusions.label: Institutional landholders (land owned by a company or trust, not a person)
exclusions.sourceQuote: All Institutional Landholders are not eligible for benefit under the scheme.

jargon.meaning: An online identity check that confirms it is really you, using your Aadhaar number.
One part of a payment that is given in several parts instead of all at once.

documentGaps: The document does not clearly state a family income limit.
Exact land ownership verification process can vary by state.
